How CalMU’s Certificate in Artificial Intelligence Helps You Compete in a Tech-Driven Market

By George Altawil
June 6, 2025
 

Artificial intelligence is no longer just a trend—it’s a workplace revolution. According to LinkedIn’s Jobs on the Rise 2024 report, roles such as Artificial Intelligence Engineer and AI Consultant are among the fastest-growing in the U.S., highlighting the increasing demand for professionals with AI-related skills across business, tech, and operations sectors. California Miramar University’s Certificate in Artificial Intelligence is designed to meet this demand by equipping learners with real-world, applicable AI knowledge in just six months.

This 18-credit program blends core business foundations with high-demand AI coursework. It’s ideal for early-career professionals, veterans exploring new career paths, or business leaders looking to sharpen their technical edge.

Program Overview 

  • Duration: 6 months
  • Format: 100% Online or Hybrid
  • Credit Hours: 18
  • Estimated Tuition: $9,144
  • Locations: San Diego or San Jose

Courses in the Certificate Program

Every course is designed to build job-ready knowledge of artificial intelligence tools and strategies: 

  • BUS 2951 - Principles of Business
    Covers key business areas like management, marketing, HR, and finance to provide a well-rounded foundation for applying AI effectively in organization.
  • AI 4000 - AI Fundamentals
    Introduce students to core AI technologies, ethical considerations, and their impact across industries.
  • AI 4001 -  Prompt Engineering in Business
    Teaches how to create and optimize AI prompts to improve decision-making and efficiency using tools like ChatGPT and other LLMs.
  • AI 4002 - AI-Driven Strategic Decision Making
    Focuses on how to analyze data, predict trends, and apply AI tools to support executive decision-making.
  • AI 4003 - AI-Driven Transformation
    Examines how AI can enhance business processes, operational efficiency, and innovation
  • AI 4004 - AI for Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
    Explores how AI can enhance customer engagement, marketing personalization, and service automation

Learning Outcomes

Graduates of the AI Certificate program will be able to:

  • Identify AI tools to support strategic business functions
  • Analyze data-driven insights to inform decisions
  • Apply AI to improve business efficiency and outcomes
  • Address ethical implications of using AI in business
  • Enhance user experience and engagement with AI strategies

Why It Matters in Today’s Job Market

A 2024 study by PwC found that 73% of U.S. CEOs expect generative AI to significantly change how their businesses operate in the next 3 years. Simultaneously, IBM’s 2023 Global AI Adoption Index reported that over 40% of businesses are actively using AI, with demand for AI talent outpacing supply.

These trends make CalMU’s AI certificate a powerful addition to your resume. Whether you're new to tech or experienced in business, this program helps you break into roles such as:

  • AI Business Analyst
  • Prompt Engineer
  • CRM Automation Specialist
  • Digital Transformation Consultant
  • Innovation Strategist

Who Should Enroll?

This certificate is ideal for:

  • Working professionals seeking to future-proof their careers
  • Business leaders who want to understand and use AI tools
  • Veterans transitioning into tech or business
  • Recent grads who want focused, practical AI training

Courses are taught by experienced faculty with backgrounds in business, technology, and applied AI. Students can complete the certificate entirely online or at CalMU’s San Diego or San Jose locations.

Take the Next Step

With CalMU’s Certificate in Artificial Intelligence, you’ll gain the confidence and technical fluency to thrive in a fast-changing workplace. Start building your AI skillset today—fully online or hybrid.
